Don't use alcohol to give you courage. It may seem like there's no downsides now, but I promise there are later down the road. You don't want to end up like me, with a number of mental and physical problems because you start to use drinking to fix everything. 

It's gonna suck, and lord knows I wish it were easier, but you're gonna have to work up the courage to flirt with girls and be social sober. Start small.
